summary: Changes how a POP's point list is interpreted as dimensions without changing the point, vertex, or primitive data. It is useful after generators or data conversions when downstream POPs or GLSL code need consistent _Dim metadata.

key_params.name: mode
key_params.note: Choose reordering dimensions or setting explicit dimensions

key_params.name: dimorder
key_params.note: Dimension index order for reorder mode

key_params.name: dim0number
key_params.note: Dimension size for the first dimension block

key_concepts: Dimension POP changes POP dimension metadata, not the underlying points, point order, vertices, primitives, or attributes.
Set Dimensions can add, remove, split, or reshape virtual dimensions as long as the product of dimensions equals the number of points.
Reorder Dimensions changes how dimension indices are interpreted and can be used to swap row/column style organization before lookup or shader workflows.
If the requested dimension product does not equal the point count, the operator warns and leaves the dimension organization unchanged.
Use Dimension POP before GLSL POP, lookup, skinning, or data-grid logic that relies on _Dim-style point organization rather than topology.
common_gotchas: The product of the new dimensions must equal the number of points or the operator warns and leaves dimensions unchanged.
Dimension POP does not reorder or modify geometry unless the chosen mode says to reorder dimensions; it mostly changes metadata interpretation.
Use it before GLSL or lookup logic that reads _Dim metadata so shader indexing matches the intended layout.
